title: Rust SF assignment APIs accept invalid identity lengths and assignments
description: Three-pass review after activating rust/lichen-core/src/sf_assignment.rs found assigned_sf_hash_based accepts any nonempty byte slice although the protocol requires an 8-byte IID, set_assigned_sf accepts invalid SF values and silently changes later fallback behavior, and make_assigned_sf_option panics on caller input. Use typed 8-byte identities and fallible validated assignment/option APIs, add exact invalid boundary tests, and preserve no_std.
close_reason: Made IID inputs exactly 8 bytes, assignment and option creation fallible, and state fields validated/private; boundary tests and no_std check pass. Post-fix correctness/security/robustness reviews are dry.
